name: Corner Bakery
description: Corner Bakery is a comedy RPG in the spirit of the GBA: a broke young capuchin, one very special banana tree, eight island turfs. Join the waitlist.

hero.speaker: Grandpa Barty
hero.line: Kid, that tree ain't normal. One bite and the whole island wants a bunch.
hero.sub: A comedy RPG in the spirit of the GBA. One broke capuchin. One very special banana tree.

image.alt: Corner Bakery: the title screen, a moonlit island with palms and a smoking volcano.

standoff.heading: Fights are conversations.
standoff.body: No swords. No guns. You win by sweet talk, fake calls, stare downs and the occasional thrown banana.

image.alt: A Standoff: Chico of the Jaguar Patrol faces Bongo. Moves: Sweet talk, Throw banana, Fake call, Stare down.

stats.label: NRV
stats.note: Nerve. Lose it, lose the round.

crew.heading: The crew, and who is after them

members.name: Grandpa Barty
members.line: Retired smuggler. Bad knees. Knows the tree.

members.name: Chico
members.line: Best friend. Only monkey in the Jaguar Patrol.

members.name: Tito
members.line: Your first dealer. Charming. Fast hands.

members.name: Auntie Plum
members.line: Green thumb. Won't discuss her past.

members.name: Big Moe
members.line: Muscle. Does not do small talk.

members.name: Jaguar Patrol
members.line: The island police. Night shift is worse.

members.name: Don Platano
members.line: CEO of Big Peel Co. Permanently furious.

islands.heading: Eight turfs. One tower. Three endings.

shown.name: Pippin Cay
shown.alt: Pippin Cay: Grandpa Barty's banana plot by the house.

shown.name: Bayou Hollow
shown.alt: A boardwalk over the water at Bayou Hollow.

thanks.speaker: Grandpa Barty
thanks.line: Got it, kid. You'll hear from us once, when the isles open. Not before.

notFound.line: You can't go that way. The tide's in.

footer: Corner Bakery · A comedy RPG · No real monkeys were harmed

waitlist.line: The isles open soon. Leave your email and we'll send one message when they do.
